statements.text: Living is not only a cognitive process but an emotive process of sense-making, of bringing signification and value into existence. Signification and valence do not exist beforehand in the world but are enacted by the living being, and sense-making in the minimal sense of viable sensorimotor conduct is cognition.

sources.quote: Living isn’t simply a cognitive process; it’s also an emotive process of sense-making, of bringing signification and value into existence.
Sense-making is tantamount to cognition, in the minimal sense of viable sensorimotor conduct.
